subject: VALUE clause
notes: RE-VERDICTED 2026-09-09 (kb/Work PB505) -- "with EACH subscript-2", plural, is now what the code computes. TableValueOdometer.DefaultTo supplies one implied subscript-2 per dimension: the fixed/ODO allocated maximum, or "in the case of a dynamic-capacity table, the expected number of occurrences". It returns null when a dimension has neither, which is exactly the source 13.18.63.3 SR22 rejects, so the caller has already diagnosed it and the fill is never unbounded. MEASURED: `05 X PIC X(2) VALUES ARE "AB" "CD" FROM (1).` subordinate to `01 T OCCURS 3.` fills all three occurrences (AB CD AB) -- a shape the previous staging refused outright.
